title: Lord Lebedev slashes Hampton Court mansion's asking price by £5.15 million
summary_full: Lord Evgeny Lebedev has lowered the asking price of his eight-bedroom mansion near Hampton Court Palace. Originally listed at £25 million, the price is now £19.85 million after four months. This Grade II-listed property has historical significance linked to King Henry VIII. The price reduction may reflect challenges in the luxury housing market in London. The property remains available for prospective buyers seeking a unique historical estate.
